title: From single-sequence structure prediction to protein fitness landscape through a composable, epistasis-aware mutation atlas
authors: Weizhe Wang; Zimu Yu; Endi Yang; Ziyu Shi; Shize Yu; Jian Hu; Yunxin Xu; Haipeng Gong
one_liner_zh: 该文提出Cerebra-Epistasis框架，将单序列结构预测与表位效应建模结合，用于多突变体蛋白质适应度景观预测，核心贡献在蛋白质结构计算与AI方法，与课题高度相关。
abstract: Mapping the multi-mutant fitness landscape is vital to protein engineering, but is challenging due to the vast combinatorial sequence space awaiting exploration. A central difficulty lies in the accurate and efficient modeling of non-additive epistatic effects among individual mutations, which partially arise from the physical inter-residue interactions prescribed by the protein structure. Existing fitness predictors usually perform well on single mutants but become less powerful for higher-order mutants, due to the lack of explicitly considering the relationship between sequence, structure and function of the target protein. Here, we present an end-to-end framework named Cerebra-Epistasis, which couples a single-sequence structure predictor that explicitly endows the structure awareness beyond the conventional sequence-fitness mapping with a downstream fitness prediction network that deliberately models the non-linear epistatic effects beyond the traditional additive terms. When evaluated across diverse assays, Cerebra-Epistasis outperforms the other state-of-the-art baselines in multi-mutant fitness prediction, with enhanced advantage over increasing mutation orders. Moreover, our special design on the epistasis modeling allows reliable extrapolation from low-order mutant data to unseen higher-order combinations, enabling one-shot inference of the overall mutation atlas from the starting sequence, a benefit that supposedly introduces three orders of magnitude acceleration in the landscape-scale prediction.
abstract_zh: 绘制多突变适应度图谱对蛋白质工程至关重要，但由于待探索的组合序列空间极为庞大，这一任务充满挑战。核心难点在于准确且高效地建模单个突变间非加性的上位效应，这些效应部分源于蛋白质结构所规定的物理残基间相互作用。现有适应度预测器通常在单突变上表现良好，但在高阶突变上效果减弱，原因在于它们未明确考虑目标蛋白质的序列、结构与功能之间的关系。在此，我们提出一个端到端框架，名为Cerebra-Epistasis，它将单序列结构预测器与下游适应度预测网络相结合，前者明确赋予超越传统序列-适应度映射的结构意识，后者则精心建模超越传统加性项的非线性上位效应。在多种检测体系中的评估显示，Cerebra-Epistasis在多突变适应度预测上优于其他最先进的基线方法，且随着突变阶数的增加优势更为显著。此外，我们在上位效应建模上的特殊设计允许从低阶突变数据可靠外推至未见的高阶组合，实现从起始序列一次性推断整体突变图谱，这一优势预计在景观尺度预测中带来三个数量级的加速。
